opening.argument: The title presents BitClub Network as "real mining" and a "real business," while the presenter goes further by endorsing BitClub Expert as a way of "getting investment, getting a return and immediate return." He then directs viewers to "bitclubexpert.com" to read about the organization. The warnings to be careful where one invests and the discussion of Ponzi schemes do not remove the effect of that endorsement and direction; together, the message solicits attention toward a paid mining or node-return opportunity rather than only warning about risk. The supplied evidence does not establish that any payout occurred or that anyone suffered a loss.
